info.title: Product Umbrella
info.description: Tracking platform API: clicks, conversions, campaigns, offers, landings, sources, stats. Source of truth for the API: test/openapi.test.mjs checks it against src/server.js in both directions, scripts/gen-api-table.mjs renders the README table from it. Panel endpoints (/api/*, /stats*) need a session cookie or a Bearer token (ADMIN_TOKEN or a personal umb_ key) when REQUIRE_LOGIN=1, which production always sets.

post.summary: Import spend rows (e.g. a Facebook Ads Manager CSV parsed in /admin)
post.description: Each row is a cost update of the campaign(s) for one local day (tz), filtered by `param` = row id (e.g. sub_id_2 = ad set id). The amount is split over the matching clicks of all listed campaigns. Idempotent: the import key `campaigns|param|id|date` is stored with the update (cost_update.importKey; cost_imports table in PostgreSQL), and a re-import of the same key replaces the previous one — clicks it no longer matches are reset to 0. Rows with the same key in one request are summed. Rows without clicks are reported (`no_matching_clicks`), never silently dropped. Recorded in the audit log (action `import`).

param.description: Tracked parameter that holds the id in click URLs: source, keyword, external_id, creative_id, ad_campaign_id, sub_id_1..sub_id_30

200.description: { ok, campaigns, param, tz, costCurrency, rows, applied, failed, clicks, cost, results: [{ row, date, id, amount, currency, clicks, cost, replaced?, merged?, error? }] }; error per row: invalid_date, invalid_id, invalid_amount, invalid_currency, no_matching_clicks

Returns current exchange rates and last update time. Rates are refreshed every 12 hours from open.er-api.com.

The panel is a single page with path URLs. The same HTML shell answers GET /, /login and every panel section: /dashboard, /campaigns, /campaigns/{id} (and /campaigns/new), /offers, /landings, /sources, /networks, /trends, /reports, /clicks, /conversions, /botlog, /buyers, /users, /keys (list: src/panel-routes.js); query strings such as /reports?group=stream&campaign=… are read by the panel. Without a session the panel shows /login?next=<page>. Static files: /admin/admin.js, /admin/admin.css. Under BASE_PATH all links carry the prefix. Not served on tracking domains (404). Any other path answers 404.
The panel used to live at /admin#/section. Answers 302 to / (under BASE_PATH); the browser keeps the #fragment and the panel turns #/campaigns into /campaigns.
